test_cases.name: Initial Quote Request for Multiple Items
test_cases.description: A verbose customer from Fresh HelloFoods requests a detailed quote for several catalog items, providing extra context and explanations for their needs. The initial email establishes the business context and requests a quote, setting up for later quote updates and order lifecycle actions.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Detailed Quote – Product Selection for Upcoming Promotion
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out on behalf of Fresh HelloFoods as we are preparing for an upcoming promotional event and would like to request a detailed quote for several items from your catalog. We are looking to feature a mix of fresh produce and fun items for our customers, so I want to ensure we get the right quantities and product types for our needs. Please see the list below:

- Mango: We are planning a fruit basket special and would like pricing for 50 units.
- Pizza: We noticed there are a few pizza options in your catalog, and we are interested in including pizza in our event menu. Could you please provide a quote for 30 pizzas? (Let us know if there are different types or sizes available, as we want to select the most suitable option.)
- Soda - Medium: For beverages, we would like to include 40 units of medium-sized sodas.
- Organic Carrot: As part of our healthy snack packs, please quote 25 units.

If you require any additional information or clarification on the above, please let us know. We are aiming to finalize our selections soon, so a prompt response would be greatly appreciated. Also, if there are any bundle offers or recommendations based on your experience with similar events, feel free to include those details.

Best regards,
Fresh HelloFoods

test_cases.name: Initial Quote Request for Toytopia Spring Promotion
test_cases.description: Toytopia sends a detailed and courteous email requesting a quote for several catalog items, providing business context and specifying quantities. The email is verbose and polite, establishing the context for a quote-to-order lifecycle, but does not yet request any order updates or unresolvable changes.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Toytopia Spring Promotion Order
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Alex, and I am reaching out on behalf of Toytopia as we are preparing for our upcoming Spring Promotion. We are looking to place an order for a selection of items from your catalog, and I would appreciate it if you could provide us with a formal quote at your earliest convenience. To help you process this efficiently, I have listed the items and quantities below:

- 12 units of the Kiddie Quest Adventure Kit
- 20 units of the MagicToyland Fairy Doll
- 15 units of the JoySprout Toy Car Set
- 10 units of the Rug (we noticed there are a few options in your catalog, so please include the available types and pricing for us to review)
- 8 units of the WonderWagon Pull-Along Train

If you require any additional information or clarification regarding our request, please do not hesitate to let me know. We are aiming to finalize our selection promptly, so your timely response would be greatly appreciated.

Best regards,
Toytopia

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request: Produce & Snacks for Weekly Supply
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

We’re gearing up for our weekly supply run and I wanted to get a quote started for a few items we’ll need. We’re looking to restock some fresh produce and snacks for our store. Here’s what we’re thinking:

- Organic Carrot (AITEM-1000): We usually go through about 40 lbs a week, so please quote for that quantity.
- Apples: We’d like to get a quote for 3 cases. If you need more info about the type or size, let me know – we’re open to suggestions based on what’s available.
- Pizza (AITEM-0051): Please quote for 10 units. We’re planning a small event, so these will be handy.
- Black Olive (AITEM-1004): We need 2 jars, preferably the standard size you carry.

If you need any more details or if there are options for the apples (like different varieties or packaging), just ask. We’re flexible and happy to clarify as needed. Looking forward to your quote and any recommendations you might have!

Best regards,
Fresh HelloFoods
